scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Excellence in Coaching
other_conditions: Must have devoted career to coaching in any major sports discipline and have coached sportspersons achieving excellence at national and international levels
Must not have been convicted of any criminal offence
Award can be conferred only once in the recipient’s lifetime
Award may be given posthumously to the next of kin of the awardee
Award may be cancelled and recovered if obtained by fraudulent means
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹1,00,000 along with a statue, scroll of honour, blazer with tie, and travel allowances (TA and DA) for a Grade ‘A’ officer.
